units.summary: New test that checks CompactSelectedSeries decrements numStaleSeries only when it evicts a stale series, and leaves the counter alone when it evicts non-stale ones. It changes no production code.
units.headline: Test numStaleSeries is decremented only when stale series are evicted
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The exported StaleHead type is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead and its refs field becomes the generic seriesRefs type. CompactStaleHead and CompactSelectedSeries now share this view. In-repo uses are updated, but importers of the old exported name will no longer compile.
units.headline: Exported StaleHead renamed to generic SelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Exported type renamed and reused by a new compaction path; public API of the tsdb package changes.
focus: downstream users of tsdb.StaleHead/NewStaleHead (e.g. Mimir/Cortex) will no longer compile

units.summary: The exported constructor is renamed from NewStaleHead and now takes the generic seriesRefs. The body is unchanged apart from the field name.
units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Exported constructor renamed, which breaks external callers of the public API.

units.summary: Index now delegates to the renamed selectedSeriesIndex with the selected refs. The logic is the same as before, under new names.
units.headline: Index delegates to renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Rename-only delegation with equivalent behavior.

units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of selected refs instead of head.NumStaleSeries(). This changes Meta().Stats.NumSeries for stale compaction too: stale series excluded for having OOO data are no longer counted. For selected-series compaction the count is now meaningful. compactor.Write recomputes the stats for the output block itself.
units.headline: NumSeries now counts selected refs, not head stale series
units.reason: Changes the value reported in the view's block meta stats, including on the existing stale path.
focus: confirm nothing relies on view Meta().Stats.NumSeries equalling head.NumStaleSeries()

units.summary: Renames the placeholder ULID constant and changes its value. A grep shows it is used only in Meta() of the view, and real block ULIDs are generated by the compactor. The new string parses as a valid 26-character ULID.
units.headline: Placeholder head-view ULID renamed and value changed
units.reason: Sentinel ULID used only in the in-memory view meta; persisted blocks get their own ULIDs.

units.summary: Meta uses the renamed sentinel ULID; otherwise it is unchanged. Its NumSeries stat comes from the updated NumSeries method.
units.headline: Meta uses renamed selectedSeriesHeadULID
units.reason: Only a receiver and constant rename.

units.summary: The String output changes from 'stale head' to 'selected-series head' and a comment typo is fixed. This only affects log and error text.
units.headline: String output now says 'selected-series head'
units.reason: Only log and error message text changes.
